checkpoints.title: Migrate [proof] retention_days to [proof.retention] per kind
contracts: config schema v2: [proof.retention] screenshot_days, recording_days, report_days; v1 retention_days maps to all three
instrumentation: upgrade logs the migrated keys and their values
checkpoints.rollback: aayu upgrade --rollback restores the v1 file from the backup the migration writes; the down step rewrites retention_days from report_days
